Two residents run a conventional two-adult household. Yuki is home most of the day, taking a morning walk (07:00–08:30 weekdays, 10:00–11:30 weekends) and a shorter afternoon errand (14:30–16:00 weekdays only). The dog is fed by Yuki at 07:00 and 18:00, walked at 08:00 and 16:45. Meals are at 07:30, 12:30, and 18:30; evening TV runs 19:30–22:00. Marco bakes on weekday mornings (06:30–08:30); Yuki bakes on weekend afternoons (14:00–16:30). Marco journals and reads at the nightstand 22:30–00:00. Yuki plays guitar 15:00–16:30 on weekdays. Marco does yoga 06:00–06:45 weekdays. Nothing of either resident's personal items travels out of the house during work hours—Marco's lunchbox, vitamins, and journal all stay at their resting spots. Yuki's jacket, keys, sunglasses, and water bottle remain at the entry during her walks (she leaves them on the hook or table).
